text_block_list.text:
If you're gonna live there, Downtown is 
definitely the place! It's the most 
Dubai-like, after all. I wanna gaze at the 
sparkling night view from the top floor of 
a skyscraper~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Still, I love Dubai Marina too~! I want a 
cruiser! I wanna eat Jasheed and watch the 
sunset at a celebrity beach party~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
And and~, what if we built a palace-like 
mansion in the Dubai desert?! Eeeeeek!!
